args.title: Corvid Packaging: Warehouse Automation in 2026 — Summary
args.body:
Combined summary of the Corvid Packaging newsletter, its linked article, and the companion piece:

• Newsletter ("Warehouse automation in 2026"): Corvid's latest newsletter highlights warehouse automation trends for 2026, linking to a feature article and a companion piece (free registration, no password required).

• Article (blog.corvid.example/2026/warehouse): Warehouses deploying autonomous carts saw pick rates rise 18%, but integration took twice as long as planned.

• Companion piece (insights.corvid.example/warehouse/companion): The biggest saving from automation was fewer mis-picks.
